title: Louis-CFM/coucou
why_read: A lightweight cross-platform menu-bar companion that monitors multiple AI coding agents at once, a nice quality-of-life tool for developers juggling several agentic coding tools.
analysis: Coucou is a small cross-platform utility, built in Swift, that sits in your menu bar or notch area and shows the status of various AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Gemini CLI. It addresses a real emerging pain point: developers now often run multiple AI coding agents in parallel and need a simple way to glance at what's happening across them without switching windows. It's not a deep technical breakthrough but a thoughtfully scoped developer-experience tool riding the current wave of agentic coding tool adoption.
